title: SmartStyler - Multi-Vendor Fashion Marketplace
description: My most ambitious research and build to date. A MERN + React Native platform combining e-commerce with fashion AI - reel-based product browsing, ML-driven recommendations, and a smart support chatbot.

detailSections.heading: Why we built it
detailSections.content:
Every app we tried either assumed a single person, ignored how couples actually share money, or made bill tracking feel like a second job. We wanted something that worked for us at the core: enter a bill once, get one notification, and nothing catches us off guard. Mortgage paydown projections so we could see the long game, not just this month. And reviews that feel like stories, not spreadsheets — because I'm very data-oriented and Erica is more visual and wants the gist. The app bleeds those two modes together.

At its heart it's built for couples and families — shared household view, rollover budgets that match real life, and month-in-review / year-in-review narratives worth actually watching.

detailSections.heading: What it does
detailSections.content:
Unified bill notifications — recurring bills and income in one place; one alert, not five.
Rollover budgeting — unspent budget rolls into next month the way we actually manage money.
Mortgage & net-worth tracking — offset, mortgage, and account snapshots with paydown projections.
Story-like reviews — month-in-review and year-in-review experiences (not just charts).
Pocket CFO — an AI assistant (OpenAI Agents SDK) for questions and planning when you want a conversation, not a pivot table.

detailSections.heading: Tech & architecture
detailSections.content:
Monorepo with pnpm workspaces + Turborepo (apps/web, apps/mobile, shared packages).
Web: Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind and Radix UI.
Mobile: native React Native with Expo (Expo Go in dev), shared types/logic via packages, Firebase push.
Data: Prisma over PostgreSQL, Supabase in the mix.
Payments: Stripe subscriptions.

title: QuickBgRemove - AI Background Remover & Image Editor
description: An AI-powered full-stack image processing application built for fast, high-quality background removal and seamless image editing. QuickBG combines AI background-removal models with image-processing capabilities to let users remove backgrounds in seconds, replace them with custom or generated backgrounds, resize images, and enhance image quality through an intuitive web interface.

detailSections.heading: Why i built it
detailSections.content: I built QuickBgRemove to solve a simple, recurring problem removing image backgrounds quickly without sacrificing quality or relying on paid or complex editing software. What started as an experiment with AI-based background removal evolved into a practical image editing tool that I and my family members actively use. I expanded the project beyond background removal by adding background replacement, AI-generated backgrounds, image resizing, Unsplash-powered background discovery, and image enhancement, turning it into a more complete image editing workflow.

detailSections.heading: What it does
detailSections.content:
AI Background Removal - Removes image backgrounds within seconds while maintaining high-quality subject edges.
Background Replacement - Replace removed backgrounds with custom images or discover backgrounds through the Unsplash API.
AI Background Generation - Generate new backgrounds to create completely different visual compositions.
Image Resizing - Resize processed images to custom dimensions.
Image Enhancement - Improve image quality using server-side Sharp processing.
Fast Image Processing - Handles AI inference and image transformations through a dedicated backend processing workflow.
Simple Editing Workflow - Upload, remove the background, customize the result, and export the edited image from one interface.

detailSections.heading: Tech & Architecture
detailSections.content:
Frontend: React + Tailwind CSS for a responsive image-editing interface.
Backend: Node.js API responsible for image processing, model integration, and application logic.
AI: Integrated Hugging Face models for AI-powered background removal and image generation capabilities.
Image Processing: Sharp for server-side resizing, optimization, format conversion, and image enhancement.
External API: Unsplash API integration for sourcing background images.
Architecture: Full-stack client/server architecture separating the interactive editing experience from AI inference and image-processing operations.
Processing Pipeline: Images are uploaded → processed through AI background removal → optionally transformed with a generated or selected background → resized/enhanced → prepared for final output.
